title: Benefit Plan Standard Schema
description: Canonical JSON schema for representing normalized health benefit plans across carriers.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan.

plan_name.description: Marketing or descriptive name of the plan.

carrier.description: Name of the issuing carrier or plan sponsor.

plan_type.description: High‑level classification of the plan (e.g. PPO, HMO, POS, Medicare Advantage).

effective_date.description: Date on which the plan becomes effective.

expiry_date.description: Date on which the plan expires or renews.

network_tiers.description: List of network tiers available for this plan.

name.description: Display name for the network tier.

accumulators.description: Plan‑level deductible and out‑of‑pocket maximum values.

applies_to.description: Coverage line the deductible applies to (e.g. medical, pharmacy).

benefits.description: List of individual benefit items included in the plan.

benefit_id.description: Unique identifier for this benefit item.

category.description: High‑level category of the benefit (e.g. physician services, emergency care).

place_of_service.description: Place(s) where the service is typically rendered (e.g. office, hospital).

network_cost_shares.description: Cost sharing details for each network tier.

tier_id.description: Identifier of the network tier this cost share applies to.

covered.description: Indicates whether the service is covered under this tier.

cost_shares.description: Sequence of cost sharing components applicable to this tier.

type.description: Type of cost share component (e.g. copay, coinsurance, deductible).

sequence.description: Order in which this cost share is applied.

amount.description: Dollar amount for copay or flat deductible; null if not applicable.

rate.description: Percentage rate for coinsurance; null if not applicable.

basis.description: Basis for cost share calculation (e.g. per_visit, allowed_amount).

notes.description: Additional notes or qualifiers for this tier’s cost share.

limits.description: Visit, day, or dollar limits applicable to this benefit.

type.description: Type of limit (e.g. visits, days, dollars).

period.description: Period over which the limit applies (e.g. per_year, per_episode).

conditions.description: Special conditions or qualifiers for this benefit (e.g. prior authorization required).

moop_applicability.description: Specifies whether cost sharing for this benefit counts toward the maximum out‑of‑pocket (MOOP). Values may include plan_default, include, or exclude.

coding_hints.description: Optional hints for mapping the benefit to coding systems like CPT or revenue codes.

source_references.description: Optional citations back to the source document used to populate this plan.

schema_version.description: Version of the Benefit Plan Standard schema used to validate this document.
